# Ophir Stays

> Locally owned vacation rental management and trip planning for a private collection of homes in Durango, Colorado. Founded by Casey Roberts, a Durango local of 23 years.

## Guests
- [Your Stay](https://ophirstays.com/stay): how a stay works, trip planning packages, ski and bike concierge
- [The Collection](https://ophirstays.com/homes): the homes

## Ride Durango
- [Durango mountain bike routes](https://ophirstays.com/trails): ten rides from town with maps, elevation profiles and free GPX
- [Durango trail map](https://ophirstays.com/trail-map): free printable map of the trail systems around Durango
- [Five rides that show you Durango](https://ophirstays.com/journal/durango-rides)

## Guides
- [Where to eat in Durango](https://ophirstays.com/journal/where-to-eat-durango)

## Owners
- [Owners](https://ophirstays.com/owners): management, fees and how to apply
- [What a Durango vacation home earns](https://ophirstays.com/journal/durango-home-earnings)
- [Durango short-term rental rules](https://ophirstays.com/journal/durango-short-term-rental-rules)
